message.content:
The Wi-Fi switch is currently OFF (the toggle is to the left and grayed out). To turn Wi-Fi on, I need to tap the switch area. The switch is located in the "Wi-Fi" row, which spans from the left edge to the right edge of the screen. The center of this row is approximately at y=378 and spans most of the width, so I should tap near the center of the switch area to enable Wi-Fi.
do(action="Tap", element=[499,378])
